channels.specular_test_scope: Sampled illumination rays only; finite-beam tails are not bounded by this flag.

detector.noise_definition: EMVA 1288 Release 4.0 Linear: temporal Eqs. 13-15; DSNU/PRNU and total SNR Eqs. 66-69. Independent-pixel spatial model. Total SNR uses nominal average QE, before pixel calibration. DCNU is an optional extension, not part of the standard. SNR is pre-clipping; quantization variance is an approximation for adequately resolved noise.
detector.detection_scope: Paired same-surface sample minus mean of independent noise reference frames. Signed contrast includes particle/haze interference and coupling. Haze photon shot noise in both frames, dark/background, read noise and ADC quantization included. Fixed DSNU/DCNU offsets cancel; fixed PRNU is retained in pixel response. Independent pixels and known contrast template; not an empirical detection probability. Residual haze mismatch RMS is a user assumption, not inferred from one PSD/FEM realization.
detector.gray_scope: Simulated single area exposures, no TDI multiplication. Same static surface and fixed sensor patterns; includes sample/reference haze shot noise, dark current, read noise and actual ADC rounding. Temporal ROI SNR, not spatial haze mismatch or hardware measurement. Full raw stacks saved only below the archive size cap; ROI DN series and first frames always saved.
detector.camera_profile_note: Gemi 8K area approximation, no TDI accumulation. QE >=63.9% at 266 nm; 12.1 e- median read noise and >=16000 e- well from Appendix 3 are assumed area inputs. 16 e-/DN and black level 64 DN are uncalibrated assumptions. The manual does not guarantee Area-mode image quality or specify whether read noise includes ADC quantization.

field_coverage.scope: Geometric sensor footprint projected to z=0; incident downward Poynting flux sampled on 17x17 points per footprint, not a rigorous continuous lower bound. Legacy beam-waist envelopes are not certified by this coverage check. Tilted wafer edges are defocused; coverage does not certify sharp imaging or uniform haze.

image_field_units: Flux normalized, not SI E/H; intensity W/um^2.
focus: Object reference plane passes through (0,0,0), perpendicular to each objective axis.
scope: Independent aplanatic air objectives with optional Zernike phase and detector. Only scattered light; no specular leakage. Detector uses total scattered with-particle flux. FEM validation limitations remain; FFT images are periodic.
status: not_converged; synthetic finite patch, not a calibrated SEM prediction
camera_replay_scope: Original paired optical irradiance unchanged; new camera/reference frames only.

mesh_validation.symmetry_scope: Left/right optical equality imposed by physically valid PMC mirror boundary for this synthetic symmetric input; not an independent convergence test.
mesh_validation.limitations: Two finite trenches, P1 tetrahedra, unvalidated domain/PML truncation and substrate optical constants. Even passing selected checks would not establish agreement with a real SEM specimen.
